title: poikilospermum oblongifolium
intro: Poikilospermum oblongifolium, commonly known as the red vine or mountain vine, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of the Pacific Islands and Southeast Asia. It is a woody vine with medicinal properties, traditionally used to treat various ailments. The health benefits of P. oblongifolium include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which have been shown to have potential in treating conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of P. oblongifolium include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including vasodilation, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory effects.
